en: A real match is four quarters of 15 minutes. The clock runs on through goals and stops only for injuries.
af: 'n Regte wedstryd is vier kwarte van 15 minute. Die horlosie loop deur ná doele en stop net vir beserings.
zu: Umdlalo wangempela unamakota amane emizuzu eyi-15. Iwashi liyaqhubeka ngisho kushaywa amagoli, limiswa kuphela uma kunokulimala.
xh: Umdlalo wokwenyani uneekota ezine zemizuzu eli-15. Iwotshi iyaqhubeka nangona kufakwa amanqaku, ime kuphela xa kukho ukwenzakala.
st: Papadi ya nnete ke dikotara tse nne tsa metsotso e 15. Nako ha e eme ha ho kentswe kolo; e ema feela bakeng sa dikotsi.
tn: Motshameko wa nnete ke dikotara di le nne tsa metsotso e 15. Nako ga e eme fa go tsenngwa kolo; e ema fela fa go na le kgobalo.
ny: Masewera enieni ndi makota anayi a mphindi 15. Nthawi siimaima chigoli chikalowa; imaima pokhapokha wina wavulala.
lg: A real match is four quarters of 15 minutes. The clock runs on through goals and stops only for injuries.
sn: A real match is four quarters of 15 minutes. The clock runs on through goals and stops only for injuries.
sw: Mechi halisi ina robo nne za dakika 15. Saa haisimami magoli yanapofungwa; husimama kwa majeraha tu.
ms: Perlawanan sebenar ialah empat suku masa 15 minit. Jam terus berjalan selepas gol dan hanya berhenti untuk kecederaan.
zh: 正式比赛分四节，每节15分钟。进球后计时不停，只有受伤时才暂停。

en: A league rule: in the last five minutes of each quarter a goal from 3 m or more out is worth two.
af: 'n Ligareël: in die laaste vyf minute van elke kwart tel 'n doel van 3 m of verder dubbel.
zu: Umthetho weligi: emizuzwini emihlanu yokugcina yekota ngayinye, igoli elishaywe ku-3 m noma ngaphezulu libalwa kabili.
xh: Umthetho weligi: kwimizuzu emihlanu yokugqibela yekota nganye, inqaku elifakwe ukusuka kwi-3 m nangaphezulu libalwa kabini.
st: Molao wa liki: metsotsong e mehlano ya ho qetela ya kotara ka nngwe, kolo e tswang 3 m kapa ho feta e ba dintlha tse pedi.
tn: Molao wa liki: mo metsotsong e metlhano ya bofelo ya kotara nngwe le nngwe, kolo e e tswang 3 m kgotsa go feta e na le dintlha di le pedi.
ny: Lamulo la ligi: mphindi zisanu zomaliza za kota iliyonse, chigoli chochokera pa 3 m kapena kupitirira chimakhala mapointi awiri.
lg: A league rule: in the last five minutes of each quarter a goal from 3 m or more out is worth two.
sn: A league rule: in the last five minutes of each quarter a goal from 3 m or more out is worth two.
sw: Sheria ya ligi: katika dakika tano za mwisho za kila robo, goli kutoka m 3 au zaidi lina thamani ya mbili.
ms: Peraturan liga: dalam lima minit terakhir setiap suku, gol dari jarak 3 m atau lebih bernilai dua.
zh: 联赛规则：每节最后五分钟内，距离3米或以上的投篮得分算两分。
si: A league rule: in the last five minutes of each quarter a goal from 3 m or more out is worth two.
ta: A league rule: in the last five minutes of each quarter a goal from 3 m or more out is worth two.
cy: Rheol cynghrair: ym mhum munud olaf pob chwarter, mae gôl o 3 m neu fwy allan yn werth dwy.

en: Team: you control whoever has the ball. One position: pick a bib on the home screen and play her all match, as a player does.
af: Span: jy beheer wie ook al die bal het. Een posisie: kies 'n borslap op die tuisskerm en speel haar die hele wedstryd, soos 'n speler doen.
zu: Iqembu: ulawula noma ubani onebhola. Isikhundla esisodwa: khetha i-bib esikrinini sasekhaya bese umdlala umdlalo wonke, njengoba kwenza umdlali.
xh: Iqela: ulawula nabani na onebhola. Isikhundla esinye: khetha i-bib kwisikrini sasekhaya uze umdlale umdlalo wonke, njengoko umdlali esenza.
st: Sehlopha: o laola mobapadi ya nang le bolo. Boemo bo le bong: kgetha bib skrineng sa lapeng mme o mo bapale papadi yohle, jwalo ka mobapadi wa nnete.
tn: Setlhopha: o laola motshameki yo o nang le bolo. Boemo bo le bongwe: tlhopha bib mo sekirining sa gae mme o mo tshameke motshameko otlhe, jaaka motshameki wa nnete.
ny: Timu: mumalamulira wosewera amene ali ndi mpira. Udindo umodzi: sankhani bib pa sikirini yoyamba ndipo musewere naye masewera onse, monga amachitira wosewera weniweni.

sn: Team: you control whoever has the ball. One position: pick a bib on the home screen and play her all match, as a player does.
sw: Timu: unamdhibiti yeyote mwenye mpira. Nafasi moja: chagua bibu kwenye skrini ya mwanzo umcheze mechi nzima, kama mchezaji halisi.
ms: Pasukan: anda kawal pemain yang memegang bola. Satu posisi: pilih bib di skrin utama dan mainkan dia sepanjang perlawanan, seperti pemain sebenar.
zh: 全队：你操控持球的球员。单一位置：在主页选择一件号码背心，整场比赛都操控她，就像真正的球员一样。

zu: Kuvuliwe: umdlali wakho uma emaphethelweni ezindawo isikhundla sakhe esivunyelwe ukungena kuzo. Kuvaliwe: weqa umugqa, unompempe abize i-offside.
xh: Ivuliwe: umdlali wakho uyema emdeni weendawo isikhundla sakhe esivumelekileyo ukungena kuzo. Ivaliwe: nyathela ngaphaya komgca, ompempe abize i-offside.
st: Bulehile: mobapadi wa hao o ema moeding wa dibaka tseo boemo ba hae bo di dumellang. Timilwe: tlola mola mme moahlodi o letsa offside.
tn: Bulegile: motshameki wa gago o ema mo moeding wa mafelo a boemo jwa gagwe bo a letlang. Tswetswe: tlola mola mme motsereganyi o letsa offside.
ny: Yayatsa: wosewera wanu amaima m'mphepete mwa malo amene udindo wake umaloledwa. Yazimitsa: mukadutsa mzere, woyimbira amaimba offside.

sn: On: your player stops at the edge of the areas her position may enter. Off: step over a line and the umpire calls offside.
sw: Washa: mchezaji wako husimama kwenye mpaka wa maeneo ambayo nafasi yake inaruhusiwa. Zima: ukivuka mstari, mwamuzi ataita kuotea.
ms: Hidup: pemain anda berhenti di sempadan kawasan yang dibenarkan untuk posisinya. Mati: langkah melepasi garisan dan pengadil panggil ofsaid.
zh: 开：你的球员会停在她所属位置可进入区域的边缘。关：越过界线，裁判就会判越区。

st: Ena ke papadi e ikemetseng. Dihlopha ke dinaha ka mabitso a tsona a tlwaelehileng; lebitso la mobapadi e mong le e mong le iqapilwe. Ha e amane le mokgatlo ofe kapa ofe o laolang, liki kapa tlhodisano.
tn: Ono ke motshameko o o ikemetseng. Ditlhopha ke dinaga ka maina a tsone a a tlwaelegileng; leina la motshameki mongwe le mongwe le itlhametswe. Ga o amane le mokgatlho ope o o laolang, liki kgotsa kgaisano.

af: 30,5 m lank en 15,25 m breed, in drie derdes. In die middel 'n sentersirkel van 0,9 m deursnee, en aan elke kant 'n doelsirkel: 'n halfsirkel 4,9 m van die doelpaal. Die ring is 3,05 m hoog, sonder 'n bord.

xh: Ubude buyi-30,5 m, ububanzi buyi-15,25 m, lahlulwe izahlulo ezintathu. Embindini kukho isangqa esiphakathi esiyi-0,9 m ububanzi, kwaye esiphelweni ngasinye kukho isangqa senqaku: isiqingatha sesangqa esiyi-4,9 m ukusuka kwipali. Iringi iphakame nge-3,05 m, ayinayo ibhodi.
st: Bolelele ba 30.5 m le bophara ba 15.25 m, ka dikarolo tse tharo. Bohareng ho na le sedikadikwe sa bohare sa 0.9 m, mme pheletsong ka nngwe sedikadikwe sa kolo: halofo ya sedikadikwe ya 4.9 m ho tloha paleng. Reng e bophahamong ba 3.05 m, ntle le boto.
tn: Boleele jwa 30.5 m le bophara jwa 15.25 m, ka dikarolo di le tharo. Fa gare go na le sediko sa bogare sa 0.9 m, mme kwa bofelong bongwe le bongwe sediko sa kolo: halofo ya sediko ya 4.9 m go tswa kwa paleng. Reng e kwa godimo ga 3.05 m, go se na boto.
ny: Kutalika 30.5 m ndi m'lifupi 15.25 m, logawidwa magawo atatu. Pakati pali chozungulira cha 0.9 m, ndipo kumapeto kulikonse kuli chozungulira cha chigoli: theka la bwalo la 4.9 m kuchokera ku ndodo. Mphete ili pamwamba pa 3.05 m, yopanda bolodi.

en: Each player wears a bib with her position, and may go only into her position's areas. A team names up to twelve; changes are made at the intervals, after a goal on request, and for injury.
af: Elke speler dra 'n borslap met haar posisie en mag net in daardie posisie se areas gaan. 'n Span benoem tot twaalf spelers; wissels word in die pouses gemaak, ná 'n doel op versoek, en vir beserings.
zu: Umdlali ngamunye ugqoka i-bib enesikhundla sakhe, futhi angangena kuphela ezindaweni zesikhundla sakhe. Iqembu liqamba abadlali abafika kweshumi nambili; ukushintsha kwenziwa ngamakhefu, ngemva kwegoli uma kucelwa, nangenxa yokulimala.
xh: Umdlali ngamnye unxiba i-bib enesikhundla sakhe, kwaye angangena kuphela kwiindawo zesikhundla sakhe. Iqela lichaza abadlali ukuya kwishumi elinesibini; utshintsho lwenziwa ngamakhefu, emva kwenqaku xa kucelwa, nangenxa yokwenzakala.
st: Mobapadi e mong le e mong o apara bib e nang le boemo ba hae, mme o kena feela dibakeng tsa boemo boo. Sehlopha se ka ngodisa ho fihla ho ba 12; diphetoho di etswa diphomolong, ka mora kolo ha ho kopilwe, le bakeng sa kotsi.
tn: Motshameki mongwe le mongwe o apara bib e e nang le boemo jwa gagwe, mme o tsena fela mo mafelong a boemo joo. Setlhopha se ka kwadisa go fitlha go ba 12; diphetogo di dirwa ka nako ya boikhutso, morago ga kolo fa go kopilwe, le fa go na le kgobalo.
ny: Wosewera aliyense amavala bib yosonyeza udindo wake, ndipo amalowa m'malo a udindo wakewo okha. Timu ikhoza kulemba osewera mpaka 12; kusintha kumachitika pa nthawi yopuma, chigoli chikalowa ngati zapemphedwa, ndiponso wina akavulala.

sw: Kila mchezaji huvaa bibu yenye nafasi yake, na huingia tu maeneo ya nafasi yake. Timu huorodhesha hadi wachezaji kumi na wawili; mabadiliko hufanywa wakati wa mapumziko, baada ya goli kwa ombi, na kwa jeraha.
ms: Setiap pemain memakai bib dengan posisinya, dan hanya boleh masuk ke kawasan posisinya. Pasukan boleh menamakan hingga dua belas; pertukaran dibuat semasa rehat, selepas gol atas permintaan, dan kerana kecederaan.
zh: 每名球员穿着标有位置的背心，只能进入该位置允许的区域。每队最多报名十二人；可在节间休息、进球后申请，以及受伤时换人。

en: Only the Goal Shooter and Goal Attack may score, and only from inside the goal circle. The ball must go right through the ring. A shot that leaves her hands before the whistle counts.
af: Net die Doelskut en Doelaanval mag doele aanteken, en net van binne die doelsirkel. Die bal moet heeltemal deur die ring gaan. 'n Skoot wat haar hande voor die fluitjie verlaat, tel.
zu: Ngu-Goal Shooter no-Goal Attack kuphela abangashaya igoli, futhi kuphela besesiyingini segoli. Ibhola kufanele lidlule ngokuphelele eringini. Ukushaya okuphume ezandleni zakhe ngaphambi kokuba kushaywe impempe kuyabalwa.
xh: NguGoal Shooter noGoal Attack kuphela abanokufaka inqaku, kwaye kuphela ngaphakathi kwesangqa senqaku. Ibhola mayidlule ngokupheleleyo kwiringi. Ukufaka okuphume ezandleni zakhe ngaphambi kwempempe kuyabalwa.
st: Ke GS le GA feela ba ka kenyang kolo, mme feela ba le ka hare ho sedikadikwe sa kolo. Bolo e tlameha ho feta ka hare ho reng ka botlalo. Ho thunya ho tswang matsohong a hae pele ho mololi ho a bala.
tn: Ke GS le GA fela ba ba ka tsenyang kolo, mme fela ba le mo teng ga sediko sa kolo. Bolo e tshwanetse go feta ka mo reng ka botlalo. Go thuntsha go go tswang mo diatleng tsa gagwe pele ga phala go a bala.
ny: GS ndi GA okha ndi omwe angagoletse, ndipo ali mkati mwa chozungulira cha chigoli. Mpira uyenera kudutsa mu mphete yonse. Kuponya komwe kwachoka m'manja mwake woyimbira asanaimbe muluzu kumawerengedwa.

ms: Hanya Penjaring Gol dan Penyerang Gol boleh menjaring, dan hanya dari dalam bulatan gol. Bola mesti melepasi gelung sepenuhnya. Tembakan yang meninggalkan tangannya sebelum wisel dikira.
zh: 只有射手和攻击射手可以得分，而且必须在射球区内投篮。球必须完全穿过篮圈。哨响前出手的投篮有效。

en: Every quarter starts with a centre pass, and so does play after every goal. They alternate, whoever scored. The Centre stands in the centre circle; the others wait in their goal thirds until the whistle, and the pass must be caught in the centre third.
af: Elke kwart begin met 'n senterpas, en so ook die spel ná elke doel. Die spanne neem beurte, ongeag wie aangeteken het. Die Senter staan in die sentersirkel; die ander wag in hul doelderdes tot die fluitjie, en die aangee moet in die middelderde gevang word.
zu: Ikota ngayinye iqala nge-centre pass, kanjalo nomdlalo ngemva kwegoli ngalinye. Amaqembu ayashintshana, noma ngubani oshaye igoli. U-Centre umi esiyingini esimaphakathi; abanye balinda ezingxenyeni zabo zegoli kuze kushaywe impempe, futhi iphasi kufanele ibanjwe engxenyeni emaphakathi.
xh: Ikota nganye iqala nge-centre pass, kunjalo nomdlalo emva kwenqaku ngalinye. Amaqela ayatshintshana, nokuba ngubani ofake inqaku. UCentre umi kwisangqa esiphakathi; abanye balinda kwizahlulo zabo zenqaku de kuvuthelwe impempe, kwaye ipasi mayibanjwe kwisahlulo esiphakathi.
st: Kotara ka nngwe e qala ka centre pass, jwalo le papadi ka mora kolo ka nngwe. Di a fapanyetsana, ho sa tsotellehe hore na ke mang ya kentseng kolo. C o ema sedikadikweng sa bohare; ba bang ba emela dikarolong tsa bona tsa kolo ho fihlela mololi, mme pase e tlameha ho tshwarwa karolong e bohareng.
tn: Kotara nngwe le nngwe e simolola ka centre pass, le motshameko morago ga kolo nngwe le nngwe. Di a refosanya, go sa kgathalesege gore ke mang yo o tsentseng kolo. C o ema mo sedikong sa bogare; ba bangwe ba emela mo dikarolong tsa bone tsa kolo go fitlha phala e lla, mme pase e tshwanetse go tshwarwa mo karolong ya bogare.
ny: Kota iliyonse imayamba ndi centre pass, chimodzimodzinso masewera chigoli chilichonse chikalowa. Matimu amasinthana, mosasamala kanthu kuti wagoletsa ndi ndani. C amaima m'chozungulira chapakati; ena amadikira m'magawo awo a chigoli mpaka muluzu, ndipo pasi iyenera kugwiridwa m'gawo lapakati.
lg: Every quarter starts with a centre pass, and so does play after every goal. They alternate, whoever scored. The Centre stands in the centre circle; the others wait in their goal thirds until the whistle, and the pass must be caught in the centre third.
sn: Every quarter starts with a centre pass, and so does play after every goal. They alternate, whoever scored. The Centre stands in the centre circle; the others wait in their goal thirds until the whistle, and the pass must be caught in the centre third.
sw: Kila robo huanza kwa pasi ya katikati, na vivyo hivyo mchezo baada ya kila goli. Timu hupokezana, bila kujali nani alifunga. Centre husimama ndani ya duara la kati; wengine husubiri katika theluthi zao za goli hadi filimbi, na pasi lazima idakwe katika theluthi ya kati.
ms: Setiap suku bermula dengan hantaran tengah, begitu juga selepas setiap gol. Ia bergilir-gilir, tidak kira siapa menjaring. Pemain Tengah berdiri dalam bulatan tengah; yang lain menunggu di pertiga gol masing-masing hingga wisel, dan hantaran mesti ditangkap di pertiga tengah.
zh: 每节以中场传球开始，每次进球后也是如此。双方轮流发球，与谁进球无关。中锋站在中圈内；其他球员在各自的底区等候哨声，传球必须在中区被接住。

en: Four quarters of 15 minutes, with four minutes between the first and second and the third and fourth, and twelve at half-time. The teams change ends each quarter.
af: Vier kwarte van 15 minute, met vier minute tussen die eerste en tweede en tussen die derde en vierde, en twaalf met rustyd. Die spanne ruil elke kwart kante om.
zu: Amakota amane emizuzu eyi-15, nemizuzu emine phakathi kwekota yokuqala neyesibili, nephakathi kweyesithathu neyesine, nemizuzu eyishumi nambili ngekhefu eliphakathi. Amaqembu ashintsha izinhlangothi ikota ngayinye.
xh: Iikota ezine zemizuzu eli-15, nemizuzu emine phakathi kwekota yokuqala neyesibini, naphakathi kweyesithathu neyesine, kunye nemizuzu elishumi elinesibini kwikhefu eliphakathi. Amaqela atshintsha amacala kwikota nganye.
st: Dikotara tse nne tsa metsotso e 15, ka metsotso e 4 pakeng tsa ya pele le ya bobedi, le ya boraro le ya bone, le metsotso e 12 halofong. Dihlopha di fapanyetsana mahlakore kotara ka nngwe.
tn: Dikotara di le nne tsa metsotso e 15, ka metsotso e 4 fa gare ga ya ntlha le ya bobedi, le ya boraro le ya bone, le metsotso e 12 ka halofo. Ditlhopha di refosanya mahlakore kotara nngwe le nngwe.
ny: Makota anayi a mphindi 15, ndi mphindi 4 pakati pa yoyamba ndi yachiwiri, ndi pakati pa yachitatu ndi yachinayi, ndi mphindi 12 pa hafu. Matimu amasinthana mbali kota iliyonse.

ms: Empat suku masa 15 minit, dengan rehat empat minit antara suku pertama dan kedua serta ketiga dan keempat, dan dua belas minit pada separuh masa. Pasukan bertukar gelanggang setiap suku.
zh: 四节，每节15分钟。第一、二节之间和第三、四节之间休息四分钟，中场休息十二分钟。每节结束后双方交换场地。

af: As 'n wedstryd 'n wenner moet hê en die telling gelyk is: twee helftes van tot sewe minute met 'n minuut tussenin, en dan gaan die spel voort tot een span twee doele voor is.
zu: Uma umdlalo kumele ube nowinile kodwa amaqembu alingana: izingxenye ezimbili ezifika emizuzwini eyisikhombisa, nomzuzu owodwa phakathi kwazo, bese kudlalwa kuze kube yilapho iqembu elilodwa lihola ngamagoli amabili.
xh: Xa umdlalo kufuneka ube nophumeleleyo kodwa amaqela alingana: izahlulo ezimbini ezide ukuya kwimizuzu esixhenxe nomzuzu omnye phakathi kwazo, emva koko umdlalo uyaqhubeka de iqela elinye likhokele ngamanqaku amabini.
st: Ha papadi e tlameha ho ba le mohlodi mme dihlopha di lekana: dihalofo tse pedi tsa ho fihla metsotsong e 7, ka motsotso o le mong pakeng tsa tsona, ebe papadi e tswela pele ho fihlela sehlopha se seng se etella pele ka dikolo tse pedi.
tn: Fa motshameko o tshwanetse go nna le mofenyi mme ditlhopha di lekana: dihalofo di le pedi tsa go fitlha go metsotso e 7, ka motsotso o le mongwe fa gare ga tsone, morago motshameko o tswelela go fitlha setlhopha sengwe se etelela pele ka dikolo di le pedi.
ny: Ngati masewera ayenera kukhala ndi wopambana koma matimu ali ofanana: mahafu awiri a mphindi mpaka 7 ndi mphindi imodzi pakati pawo, kenako masewera amapitirira mpaka timu imodzi itatsogola ndi zigoli ziwiri.

ms: Jika perlawanan mesti ada pemenang dan keputusan seri: dua separuh masa hingga tujuh minit dengan rehat seminit, kemudian permainan diteruskan hingga satu pasukan mendahului dua gol.
zh: 必须分出胜负而比分持平时：进行两个最多七分钟的半场，中间休息一分钟，之后继续比赛，直到一队领先两球为止。

en: With the ball she may not run. The foot she lands on is her landing foot: she may step with the other and pivot on it, but once she lifts it she must pass or shoot before it touches the floor again. A free pass to the other side.
af: Met die bal mag sy nie hardloop nie. Die voet waarop sy land, is haar landingsvoet: sy mag met die ander voet tree en daarop draai, maar sodra sy dit oplig, moet sy aangee of skiet voordat dit weer die vloer raak. 'n Vrypas aan die ander span.
zu: Uma ephethe ibhola akavunyelwe ukugijima. Unyawo ehlela ngalo yilona lwakhe lokwehlela: angathatha isinyathelo ngolunye unyawo futhi azungeze kulo, kodwa uma eseluphakamisile, kufanele adlulise noma ashaye ngaphambi kokuba luthinte phansi futhi. Iphasi yamahhala eqenjini eliphikisayo.
xh: Xa ephethe ibhola akavumelekanga ukubaleka. Unyawo ahlala ngalo lunyawo lwakhe lokuhla: angathatha inyathelo ngolunye unyawo aze ajikeleze kulo, kodwa xa eluphakamisile, kufuneka agqithise okanye afake ngaphambi kokuba luchukumise umgangatho kwakhona. Ipasi yasimahla kwelinye iqela.
st: Ha a tshwere bolo ha a dumellwe ho matha. Leoto leo a theohelang hodima lona ke leoto la hae la ho theoha: a ka hata ka le leng mme a pota hodima lona, empa hang ha a le phahamisa o tlameha ho fetisa kapa ho thunya pele le ama fatshe hape. Pase ya mahala ho sehlopha se seng.
tn: Fa a tshwere bolo ga a letlelelwe go taboga. Lonao lo a fologelang mo go lone ke lonao lwa gagwe lwa go fologa: a ka gata ka lo lengwe mme a dikologa mo go lone, mme fa a sena go lo tsholetsa o tshwanetse go fetisa kgotsa go thuntsha pele lo ama fa fatshe gape. Pase ya mahala go setlhopha se sengwe.
ny: Ali ndi mpira saloledwa kuthamanga. Phazi limene watera nalo ndi phazi lake lotera: akhoza kuponda ndi linalo ndi kuzungulira pa ilo, koma akangolikweza ayenera kupereka kapena kuponya lisanakhudzenso pansi. Pasi yaulere kwa timu inayo.

ms: Ketika memegang bola dia tidak boleh berlari. Kaki yang mendarat dahulu ialah kaki pendaratannya: dia boleh melangkah dengan kaki lain dan berpusing padanya, tetapi sebaik diangkat dia mesti menghantar atau menjaring sebelum kaki itu menyentuh lantai semula. Hantaran bebas kepada lawan.

af: Sy moet binne drie sekondes nadat sy die bal gevang het, aangee of skiet. Gehoue bal: 'n vrypas.
zu: Kufanele adlulise noma ashaye kungakapheli imizuzwana emi-3 ebambe ibhola. Ukubamba isikhathi eside: iphasi yamahhala.
xh: Kufuneka agqithise okanye afake kwimizuzwana emithathu emva kokubamba ibhola. Ukubambelela ebholeni: ipasi yasimahla.
st: O tlameha ho fetisa kapa ho thunya nakong ya metsotswana e meraro ka mora ho tshwara bolo. Held ball: pase ya mahala.
tn: O tshwanetse go fetisa kgotsa go thuntsha mo metsotswaneng e meraro morago ga go tshwara bolo. Held ball: pase ya mahala.
ny: Ayenera kupereka kapena kuponya pasanathe masekondi atatu atagwira mpira. Held ball: pasi yaulere.

en: A defender trying to block or take the ball must stand at least 0.9 m from the landing foot of the player with it. Closer, it is obstruction: a penalty pass.
af: 'n Verdediger wat die bal probeer keer of vat, moet minstens 0,9 m van die landingsvoet van die speler met die bal staan. Nader as dit is obstruksie: 'n strafpas.
zu: Umvikeli ozama ukuvimba noma ukuthatha ibhola kufanele eme okungenani ku-0,9 m ukusuka onyaweni lokwehlela lomdlali onebhola. Uma esondele ngaphezu kwalokho, kuwukuvimba: iphasi yesijeziso.
xh: Umkhuseli ozama ukuvala okanye ukuthatha ibhola kufuneka eme ubuncinane kwi-0,9 m ukusuka kunyawo lokuhla lomdlali onebhola. Ukuba usondele ngaphezu koko, kukuthintela: ipasi yesohlwayo.
st: Mosireletsi ya lekang ho thibela kapa ho hapa bolo o tlameha ho ema bonyane 0.9 m ho tloha leotong la ho theoha la mobapadi ya nang le bolo. Ha a le haufi ho feta moo, ke thibelo (obstruction): pase ya kotlo.
tn: Mosireletsi yo o lekang go kganela kgotsa go thopa bolo o tshwanetse go ema bonnye 0.9 m go tswa mo lonaong lwa go fologa lwa motshameki yo o nang le bolo. Fa a le gaufi go feta foo, ke kganelo (obstruction): pase ya kotlhao.
ny: Wotchinga amene akufuna kutseka kapena kulanda mpira ayenera kuima osachepera 0.9 m kuchokera ku phazi lotera la wosewera amene ali ndi mpira. Akayandikira kuposa pamenepo, ndi kutsekereza (obstruction): pasi ya chilango.

en: No contact that interferes with an opponent's play: pushing, holding, knocking the ball from her hands, or not leaving a player who has won the ball room to land. A penalty pass.
af: Geen kontak wat 'n teenstander se spel belemmer nie: stoot, vashou, die bal uit haar hande slaan, of 'n speler wat die bal gewen het nie plek gee om te land nie. 'n Strafpas.
zu: Akukho ukuthintana okuphazamisa umdlalo wembangi: ukusunduza, ukubamba, ukushaya ibhola liphume ezandleni zakhe, noma ukungamniki isikhala sokwehla umdlali othole ibhola. Iphasi yesijeziso.
xh: Akukho kuchukumisana kuphazamisa umdlalo womchasi: ukutyhala, ukubamba, ukubetha ibhola iphume ezandleni zakhe, okanye ukungamniki indawo yokuhla umdlali ofumene ibhola. Ipasi yesohlwayo.
st: Ha ho ho thulana ho kenang dipapading tsa mohanyetsi: ho sutumetsa, ho tshwara, ho otla bolo matsohong a hae, kapa ho se fe mobapadi ya hapileng bolo sebaka sa ho theoha. Pase ya kotlo.
tn: Ga go letlelelwe go thulana mo go kgoreletsang motshameko wa moganetsi: go kgarametsa, go tshwara, go itaya bolo mo diatleng tsa gagwe, kgotsa go sa neye motshameki yo o thopileng bolo sebaka sa go fologa. Pase ya kotlhao.
ny: Palibe kukhudzana kosokoneza masewera a wotsutsana naye: kukankha, kugwira, kumenya mpira m'manja mwake, kapena kusapatsa malo otera wosewera amene walanda mpira. Pasi ya chilango.

sn: No contact that interferes with an opponent's play: pushing, holding, knocking the ball from her hands, or not leaving a player who has won the ball room to land. A penalty pass.

ms: Tiada sentuhan yang mengganggu permainan lawan: menolak, memegang, menepis bola dari tangannya, atau tidak memberi ruang kepada pemain yang mendapat bola untuk mendarat. Hantaran penalti.
zh: 不得以接触干扰对手比赛：推人、拉人、把球从她手中打掉，或不给已得球的球员留出落地空间。判罚球传球。

en: A player who steps into an area her position may not enter, with or without the ball, is offside. The lines are part of the areas they enclose. A free pass.
af: 'n Speler wat, met of sonder die bal, in 'n area trap waar haar posisie nie mag gaan nie, is buitespel. Die lyne is deel van die areas wat hulle omsluit. 'n Vrypas.
zu: Umdlali ongena endaweni isikhundla sakhe esingavunyelwe ukungena kuyo, enebhola noma engenalo, use-offside. Imigqa iyingxenye yezindawo ezizungezwe yiyo. Iphasi yamahhala.
xh: Umdlali ongena kwindawo isikhundla sakhe esingavumelekanga ukungena kuyo, enebhola okanye engenayo, use-offside. Imigca iyinxalenye yeendawo ezijikelezwe yiyo. Ipasi yasimahla.

en: A free pass is taken where the fault was, by any player allowed there. For a penalty pass the player penalised stands beside the thrower, out of play, until the ball is released. In the goal circle a penalty may be a pass or a shot.
af: 'n Vrypas word geneem waar die oortreding was, deur enige speler wat daar mag wees. By 'n strafpas staan die gestrafte speler langs die gooier, uit die spel, tot die bal gelos is. In die doelsirkel kan 'n straf 'n aangee of 'n skoot wees.
zu: Iphasi yamahhala yenziwa lapho iphutha lenzeke khona, yinoma yimuphi umdlali ovunyelwe ukuba lapho. Ephasini yesijeziso, umdlali ojeziswayo umi eceleni komjikijeli, engadlali, kuze kudedelwe ibhola. Esiyingini segoli, isijeziso singaba yiphasi noma ukushaya.
xh: Ipasi yasimahla yenziwa apho impazamo yenzeke khona, nguye nawuphi na umdlali ovumelekileyo ukuba alapho. Kwipasi yesohlwayo, umdlali ohlwaywayo umi ecaleni komphosi, engadlali, de ibhola ikhululwe. Kwisangqa senqaku, isohlwayo singaba yipasi okanye ukufaka.
st: Pase ya mahala e nkuwa moo phoso e etsahetseng teng, ke mobapadi ofe kapa ofe ya dumelletsweng moo. Pasing ya kotlo, mobapadi ya fuweng kotlo o ema pela ya akgelang, a se papading, ho fihlela bolo e lokollwa. Sedikadikweng sa kolo, kotlo e ka ba pase kapa ho thunya.
tn: Pase ya mahala e tsewa fa phoso e diragetseng teng, ke motshameki ope yo o letleletsweng go nna foo. Mo paseng ya kotlhao, motshameki yo o otlhaiwang o ema fa thoko ga yo o latlhelang, a sa tshameke, go fitlha bolo e latlhelwa. Mo sedikong sa kolo, kotlhao e ka nna pase kgotsa go thuntsha.
ny: Pasi yaulere imaperekedwa pamene cholakwa chinachitikira, ndi wosewera aliyense woloredwa kukhala pamenepo. Pa pasi ya chilango, wosewera wolangidwayo amaima pambali pa woponya, osasewera, mpaka mpira utaponyedwa. M'chozungulira cha chigoli, chilango chikhoza kukhala pasi kapena kuponya.

en: The umpire lets play run on when stopping it would cost the team that was fouled: a shooter about to shoot, say. She calls the advantage and the foul.
af: Die skeidsregter laat die spel aangaan as 'n fluitjie die span teen wie oortree is, sou benadeel: byvoorbeeld 'n skut wat op die punt is om te skiet. Sy roep die voordeel én die oortreding.
zu: Unompempe uvumela umdlalo uqhubeke uma ukuwumisa kungalimaza iqembu elonelwe: isibonelo, umshayi osezoshaya. Umemezela inzuzo kanye nephutha.
xh: Umpempe uvumela umdlalo uqhubeke xa ukuwumisa bekuya kulimaza iqela elonelweyo: umzekelo, umfaki osele eza kufaka. Ubiza inzuzo kunye nempazamo.
st: Moahlodi o tlohela papadi e tswele pele ha ho e emisa ho ka utlwisa sehlopha se entsweng phoso bohloko: ka mohlala, GS ya seng a tla thunya. O bolela monyetla le phoso.
tn: Motsereganyi o letla motshameko go tswelela fa go o emisa go ka latlhegela setlhopha se se diretsweng phoso: sekai, GS yo o setseng a thuntsha. O bolela monyetla le phoso.
ny: Woyimbira amalola masewera kupitirira ngati kuwaimitsa kungapweteke timu yomwe yalakwiridwa: mwachitsanzo, GS yemwe watsala pang'ono kuponya. Amalengeza mwayi ndi cholakwacho.

en: For repeated or dangerous play an umpire may warn a player, suspend her for two minutes of playing time, or order her off. Since 2024 there is no toss-up: when two players offend at once, the team last with the ball keeps it.
af: Vir herhaalde of gevaarlike spel kan 'n skeidsregter 'n speler waarsku, haar vir twee minute speeltyd skors, of haar van die baan stuur. Sedert 2024 is daar geen opgooi nie: as twee spelers gelyk oortree, behou die span wat laaste die bal gehad het dit.
zu: Ngokudlala okuphindaphindwayo noma okuyingozi, unompempe angaxwayisa umdlali, amumise imizuzu emibili yesikhathi sokudlala, noma amkhiphe enkundleni. Kusukela ngo-2024 akusekho i-toss-up: uma abadlali ababili benza iphutha ngasikhathi sinye, iqembu obeligcine ukuba nebhola liyaligcina.
xh: Ngokudlala okuphindaphindiweyo okanye okuyingozi, umpempe angalumkisa umdlali, amnqumamise imizuzu emibini yexesha lokudlala, okanye amkhuphe ebaleni. Ukususela ngo-2024 akusekho toss-up: xa abadlali ababini bephazama ngaxeshanye, iqela ebeligqibele ukuba nebhola liyayigcina.
st: Bakeng sa papadi e pheta-phetwang kapa e kotsi, moahlodi a ka lemosa mobapadi, a mo emisa metsotso e mmedi ya nako ya papadi, kapa a mo ntsha. Ho tloha 2024 ha ho sa na toss-up: ha babapadi ba babedi ba etsa phoso ka nako e le nngwe, sehlopha se neng se qetetse ho ba le bolo se a e boloka.
tn: Ka ntlha ya motshameko o o boeleditsweng kgotsa o o kotsi, motsereganyi a ka tlhagisa motshameki, a mo emisa metsotso e mebedi ya nako ya motshameko, kgotsa a mo ntsha. Go simolola ka 2024 ga go sa na toss-up: fa batshameki ba babedi ba dira phoso ka nako e le nngwe, setlhopha se se neng se na le bolo la bofelo se a e boloka.
ny: Chifukwa cha masewera obwerezabwereza kapena oopsa, woyimbira akhoza kuchenjeza wosewera, kumuimitsa kwa mphindi ziwiri za nthawi yamasewera, kapena kumutulutsa. Kuyambira 2024 palibe toss-up: osewera awiri akalakwira nthawi imodzi, timu yomwe inali ndi mpira komaliza imasunga mpirawo.

en: Some leagues play variations. The game offers the Double Zone: in the last five minutes of each quarter, a goal from 3 m or more from the post counts two.
af: Sommige ligas speel variasies. Die speletjie bied die Dubbelsone: in die laaste vyf minute van elke kwart tel 'n doel van 3 m of verder van die paal dubbel.
zu: Amanye amaligi adlala ngezinguquko. Lo mdlalo unikeza i-Double Zone: emizuzwini emihlanu yokugcina yekota ngayinye, igoli elishaywe ku-3 m noma ngaphezulu ukusuka epalini libalwa kabili.
xh: Ezinye iiligi zidlala ngeenguqu. Lo mdlalo unika i-Double Zone: kwimizuzu emihlanu yokugqibela yekota nganye, inqaku elifakwe kwi-3 m nangaphezulu ukusuka kwipali libalwa kabini.
st: Diliki tse ding di bapala ka diphapang. Papadi ena e fana ka Double Zone: metsotsong e mehlano ya ho qetela ya kotara ka nngwe, kolo e tswang 3 m kapa ho feta ho tloha paleng e ba dintlha tse pedi.
tn: Diliki dingwe di tshameka ka diphetogo. Motshameko ono o neela Double Zone: mo metsotsong e metlhano ya bofelo ya kotara nngwe le nngwe, kolo e e tswang 3 m kgotsa go feta go tswa kwa paleng e na le dintlha di le pedi.
ny: Maligi ena amasewera mosiyanako. Masewerawa ali ndi Double Zone: mphindi zisanu zomaliza za kota iliyonse, chigoli chochokera pa 3 m kapena kupitirira kuchokera ku ndodo chimakhala mapointi awiri.

sn: Some leagues play variations. The game offers the Double Zone: in the last five minutes of each quarter, a goal from 3 m or more from the post counts two.
sw: Baadhi ya ligi hucheza kwa tofauti. Mchezo huu unatoa Eneo Maradufu: katika dakika tano za mwisho za kila robo, goli kutoka m 3 au zaidi kutoka nguzo huhesabiwa mbili.
ms: Sesetengah liga bermain dengan variasi. Permainan ini menawarkan Zon Berganda: dalam lima minit terakhir setiap suku, gol dari 3 m atau lebih dari tiang dikira dua.
zh: 一些联赛采用变体规则。本游戏提供双分区：每节最后五分钟内，距篮柱3米或以上的投篮得分算两分。

en: The left thumb anywhere on the left of the screen is a joystick: it runs your player (the lime ring). Lead into space to get free for a pass.
af: Jou linkerduim enige plek op die linkerkant van die skerm is 'n stuurstok: dit laat jou speler hardloop (die lemmetjiegroen ring). Beweeg na oop spasie om vry te kom vir 'n aangee.
zu: Isithupha sakho sobunxele noma kuphi ngakwesobunxele sesikrini siyijoystick: sigijimisa umdlali wakho (iringi eluhlaza okukhanyayo). Gijimela esikhaleni ukuze ukhululeke uthole iphasi.
xh: Ubhontsi wasekhohlo naphi na kwicala lasekhohlo lesikrini yijoystick: ubalekisa umdlali wakho (iringi eluhlaza okhanyayo). Baleka uye kwindawo evulekileyo ukuze ukhululeke ufumane ipasi.
st: Monwana o motona o letshehadi kae kapa kae ka lehlakoreng le letshehadi la skrine ke joystick: o tsamaisa mobapadi wa hao (reng e tala). Matha sebakeng se se nang motho hore o lokolohe bakeng sa pase.
tn: Monwana o motona wa molema gongwe le gongwe mo letlhakoreng la molema la sekirini ke joystick: o tsamaisa motshameki wa gago (reng e tala). Taboga o ya mo sebakeng se se se nang motho gore o gololesege go amogela pase.
ny: Chala chachikulu chakumanzere paliponse kumanzere kwa sikirini ndi joystick: chimayendetsa wosewera wanu (mphete yobiriwira). Thamangirani pamalo opanda anthu kuti mulandire pasi.

sn: The left thumb anywhere on the left of the screen is a joystick: it runs your player (the lime ring). Lead into space to get free for a pass.
sw: Kidole gumba cha kushoto popote upande wa kushoto wa skrini ni jostiki: humwendesha mchezaji wako (pete ya kijani-limau). Kimbilia nafasi wazi ili upate pasi.
ms: Ibu jari kiri di mana-mana bahagian kiri skrin ialah kayu bedik: ia menggerakkan pemain anda (gelang hijau limau). Lari ke ruang kosong untuk bebas menerima hantaran.
zh: 左手拇指放在屏幕左侧任意位置即为摇杆：操控你的球员（黄绿色光圈）。跑向空当，摆脱防守接传球。

en: With the ball she cannot run. Push the stick toward a team-mate to pick her (a ring shows who), then PASS for a chest or shoulder pass, or LOB to go over a defender. The ring over the ball is your three seconds.
af: Met die bal kan sy nie hardloop nie. Druk die stok na 'n spanmaat om haar te kies ('n ring wys wie), dan AANGEE vir 'n bors- of skouerpas, of LOB om oor 'n verdediger te gooi. Die ring oor die bal is jou drie sekondes.
zu: Uma ephethe ibhola akakwazi ukugijima. Cindezela induku ubhekise kozakwenu ukuze umkhethe (iringi ikhombisa ukuthi ngubani), bese uthinta DLULISA ukuze kube iphasi yesifuba noma yehlombe, noma PHEZULU ukuze udlule phezu komvikeli. Iringi engaphezu kwebhola yimizuzwana yakho emithathu.
xh: Xa ephethe ibhola akakwazi ukubaleka. Tyhala induku ujonge kumdlali weqela lakho ukuze umkhethe (iringi ibonisa ukuba ngubani), emva koko GQITHISA ukwenzela ipasi yesifuba okanye yegxalaba, okanye PHEZULU ukudlula phezu komkhuseli. Iringi ephezu kwebhola yimizuzwana yakho emithathu.
st: Ha a tshwere bolo ha a kgone ho matha. Sutumetsa joystick ho ya ho molekane ho mo kgetha (reng e bontsha hore ke mang), ebe FETISA bakeng sa pase ya sefuba kapa ya lehetla, kapa PHAHAMISA ho feta hodima mosireletsi. Reng e hodima bolo ke metsotswana ya hao e meraro.
tn: Fa a tshwere bolo ga a kgone go taboga. Sunya joystick go ya kwa mogaabo go mo tlhopha (reng e bontsha gore ke mang), go tswa foo FETISA ya pase ya sehuba kgotsa ya legetla, kgotsa TSHOLETSA go feta godimo ga mosireletsi. Reng e e godimo ga bolo ke metsotswana ya gago e meraro.
ny: Ali ndi mpira sangathamange. Kankhirani joystick kwa mnzake kuti mumusankhe (mphete imasonyeza kuti ndi ndani), kenako PEREKA kuti mupereke pa chifuwa kapena pa phewa, kapena KWEZA kuti mudutse pamwamba pa wotchinga. Mphete pamwamba pa mpira ndi masekondi anu atatu.
lg: With the ball she cannot run. Push the stick toward a team-mate to pick her (a ring shows who), then PASS for a chest or shoulder pass, or LOB to go over a defender. The ring over the ball is your three seconds.
sn: With the ball she cannot run. Push the stick toward a team-mate to pick her (a ring shows who), then PASS for a chest or shoulder pass, or LOB to go over a defender. The ring over the ball is your three seconds.
sw: Akiwa na mpira hawezi kukimbia. Sukuma jostiki kuelekea mwenzako ili umchague (pete inaonyesha nani), kisha PASI kwa pasi ya kifua au bega, au INUA kupitisha juu ya mlinzi. Pete juu ya mpira ni sekunde zako tatu.
ms: Ketika memegang bola dia tidak boleh berlari. Tolak kayu ke arah rakan sepasukan untuk memilihnya (gelang menunjukkan siapa), kemudian HANTAR untuk hantaran dada atau bahu, atau LAMBUNG untuk melepasi pemain pertahanan. Gelang atas bola ialah tiga saat anda.
zh: 持球时她不能跑。把摇杆推向队友来选择她（光圈会标示），然后按“传球”做胸前或肩上传球，或按“高吊”越过防守球员。球上的圆环就是你的三秒。

en: SHOOT appears when your Goal Shooter or Goal Attack has the ball in the circle. Closer is surer; a defender's arm over the ball makes it harder.
af: SKIET verskyn wanneer jou Doelskut of Doelaanval die bal in die sirkel het. Hoe nader, hoe sekerder; 'n verdediger se arm oor die bal maak dit moeiliker.
zu: SHAYA iyavela uma u-Goal Shooter noma u-Goal Attack wakho enebhola esiyingini. Eduze kuqinisekile kakhulu; ingalo yomvikeli phezu kwebhola yenza kube nzima.
xh: FAKA iyavela xa uGoal Shooter okanye uGoal Attack wakho enebhola esangqeni. Ukusondela kuqinisekisa ngakumbi; ingalo yomkhuseli phezu kwebhola yenza kube nzima.
st: THUNYA e hlaha ha GS kapa GA wa hao a na le bolo ka hare ho sedikadikwe. Ha a le haufi ho bonolo; letsoho la mosireletsi hodima bolo le etsa hore ho be thata.
tn: THUNTSHA e tlhagelela fa GS kgotsa GA wa gago a na le bolo mo teng ga sediko. Fa a le gaufi go bonolo; letsogo la mosireletsi godimo ga bolo le dira gore go nne thata.
ny: PONYA imaoneka GS kapena GA wanu ali ndi mpira m'chozungulira. Akakhala pafupi n'kosavuta; mkono wa wotchinga pamwamba pa mpira umavutitsa.

sn: SHOOT appears when your Goal Shooter or Goal Attack has the ball in the circle. Closer is surer; a defender's arm over the ball makes it harder.
sw: PIGA huonekana Goal Shooter au Goal Attack wako anapokuwa na mpira ndani ya duara. Karibu zaidi ni uhakika zaidi; mkono wa mlinzi juu ya mpira huongeza ugumu.
ms: JARING muncul apabila Penjaring Gol atau Penyerang Gol anda memegang bola dalam bulatan. Lebih dekat lebih pasti; tangan pemain pertahanan di atas bola menyukarkannya.
zh: 当你的射手或攻击射手在射球区内持球时，会出现“投篮”。越近越准；防守球员的手臂挡在球上方会更难投中。

en: DEFEND puts your arms up over the ball. Watch the ring round her landing foot: green is legal, red is closer than 0.9 m and the umpire will call obstruction.
af: VERDEDIG sit jou arms op oor die bal. Hou die ring om haar landingsvoet dop: groen is wettig, rooi is nader as 0,9 m en die skeidsregter sal obstruksie blaas.
zu: VIKELA iphakamisa izingalo zakho phezu kwebhola. Bheka iringi ezungeze unyawo lwakhe lokwehlela: okuluhlaza kuvumelekile, okubomvu kusondele ngaphezu kuka-0,9 m futhi unompempe uzobiza ukuvimba.
xh: KHUSELA iphakamisa iingalo zakho phezu kwebhola. Jonga iringi ejikeleze unyawo lwakhe lokuhla: eluhlaza ivumelekile, ebomvu isondele ngaphezu kwe-0,9 m kwaye umpempe uya kubiza ukuthintela.
st: SIRELETSA e phahamisa matsoho a hao hodima bolo. Sheba reng e potileng leoto la hae la ho theoha: e tala e molaong, e kgubedu e haufi ho feta 0.9 m mme moahlodi o tla letsa thibelo.
tn: SIRELETSA e tsholetsa matsogo a gago godimo ga bolo. Leba reng e e dikologileng lonao lwa gagwe lwa go fologa: e tala e mo molaong, e khibidu e gaufi go feta 0.9 m mme motsereganyi o tla letsa kganelo.
ny: TETEZA imakweza manja anu pamwamba pa mpira. Onani mphete yozungulira phazi lake lotera: yobiriwira ndi yovomerezeka, yofiira ndi yoyandikira kuposa 0.9 m ndipo woyimbira adzaimba kutsekereza.
lg: DEFEND puts your arms up over the ball. Watch the ring round her landing foot: green is legal, red is closer than 0.9 m and the umpire will call obstruction.
sn: DEFEND puts your arms up over the ball. Watch the ring round her landing foot: green is legal, red is closer than 0.9 m and the umpire will call obstruction.
sw: LINDA huinua mikono yako juu ya mpira. Tazama pete inayozunguka mguu wake wa kutua: kijani ni halali, nyekundu ni karibu zaidi ya m 0.9 na mwamuzi ataita uzuiaji.
ms: HALANG mengangkat tangan anda di atas bola. Perhatikan gelang di sekeliling kaki pendaratannya: hijau sah, merah bermakna kurang 0.9 m dan pengadil akan panggil halangan.
zh: 按“防守”会把双臂举到球上方。留意她着地脚周围的圆环：绿色为合法，红色表示距离不足0.9米，裁判会判阻挡。

cy: Mae AMDDIFFYN yn codi eich breichiau dros y bêl. Gwyliwch y cylch o amgylch ei throed glanio: gwyrdd yn gyfreithlon, coch yn nes na 0.9 m a bydd y dyfarnwr yn galw rhwystro.

en: INTERCEPT leaps for a pass in the air if you can reach it in time. Lunge at a player holding the ball and it is contact.
af: ONDERSKEP spring vir 'n aangee in die lug as jy dit betyds kan bereik. Duik na 'n speler wat die bal vashou, en dit is kontak.
zu: HLWITHA igxumela iphasi esemoyeni uma ungayifinyelela ngesikhathi. Uma ugxumela umdlali ophethe ibhola, kuwukuthintana.
xh: XHWILA itsibela ipasi esemoyeni ukuba unokufikelela kuyo ngexesha. Ukuba utsibela umdlali ophethe ibhola, kukuchukumisana.
st: HAPA e tlolela pase e moyeng haeba o ka e fihlella ka nako. Ha o itahlela ho mobapadi ya tshwereng bolo, ke ho thulana.
tn: THOPA e tlolela pase e e mo moweng fa o ka e fitlhelela ka nako. Fa o itatlhela mo motshameking yo o tshwereng bolo, ke go thulana.
ny: LANDA imadumphira pasi yomwe ili mlengalenga ngati mungaifikire pa nthawi. Mukadziponya kwa wosewera amene wagwira mpira, ndiye kukhudzana.

sn: INTERCEPT leaps for a pass in the air if you can reach it in time. Lunge at a player holding the ball and it is contact.
sw: NASA huruka kunasa pasi hewani ukiweza kuifikia kwa wakati. Ukimrukia mchezaji aliyeshika mpira, ni kugusana.
ms: PINTAS melompat untuk hantaran di udara jika sempat dicapai. Menerkam pemain yang memegang bola dikira sentuhan.
zh: 如果来得及，按“拦截”会跃起截下空中的传球。扑向持球球员则会被判身体接触。

en: Playing as the team, you control whoever has the ball, and SWITCH moves you to the defender nearest it. Pick a bib on the home screen to play one position all match.
af: As jy as die span speel, beheer jy wie ook al die bal het, en WISSEL skuif jou na die verdediger naaste daaraan. Kies 'n borslap op die tuisskerm om een posisie die hele wedstryd te speel.
zu: Uma udlala njengeqembu, ulawula noma ubani onebhola, futhi SHINTSHA ikuyisa kumvikeli oseduze nalo. Khetha i-bib esikrinini sasekhaya ukuze udlale isikhundla esisodwa umdlalo wonke.
xh: Xa udlala njengeqela, ulawula nabani na onebhola, kwaye TSHINTSHA ikusa kumkhuseli okufutshane nayo. Khetha i-bib kwisikrini sasekhaya ukuze udlale isikhundla esinye umdlalo wonke.
st: Ha o bapala jwalo ka sehlopha, o laola mobapadi ya nang le bolo, mme FETOLA e o isa ho mosireletsi ya haufi le yona. Kgetha bib skrineng sa lapeng ho bapala boemo bo le bong papadi yohle.
tn: Fa o tshameka jaaka setlhopha, o laola motshameki yo o nang le bolo, mme FETOLA e go isa kwa mosireletsing yo o gaufi le yone. Tlhopha bib mo sekirining sa gae go tshameka boemo bo le bongwe motshameko otlhe.
ny: Mukamasewera ngati timu, mumalamulira wosewera amene ali ndi mpira, ndipo SINTHA imakusamutsirani kwa wotchinga woyandikira mpirawo. Sankhani bib pa sikirini yoyamba kuti musewere udindo umodzi masewera onse.
lg: Playing as the team, you control whoever has the ball, and SWITCH moves you to the defender nearest it. Pick a bib on the home screen to play one position all match.
sn: Playing as the team, you control whoever has the ball, and SWITCH moves you to the defender nearest it. Pick a bib on the home screen to play one position all match.
sw: Ukicheza kama timu, unamdhibiti yeyote mwenye mpira, na BADILI hukuhamishia kwa mlinzi aliye karibu zaidi na mpira. Chagua bibu kwenye skrini ya mwanzo ili ucheze nafasi moja mechi nzima.
ms: Bermain sebagai pasukan, anda kawal pemain yang memegang bola, dan TUKAR memindahkan anda ke pemain pertahanan paling dekat dengannya. Pilih bib di skrin utama untuk bermain satu posisi sepanjang perlawanan.
zh: 操控全队时，你控制持球的球员，按“切换”可转到离球最近的防守球员。在主页选择一件号码背心，可整场只打一个位置。

ta: Playing as the team, you control whoever has the ball, and SWITCH moves you to the defender nearest it. Pick a bib on the home screen to play one position all match.
cy: Wrth chwarae fel y tîm, chi sy'n rheoli pwy bynnag sydd â'r bêl, ac mae NEWID yn eich symud i'r amddiffynnwr agosaf ati. Dewiswch fib ar y sgrin gartref i chwarae un safle drwy'r gêm.

en: Eight nations near your own in the world ranking, in two pools of four. The top two of each go through to the semi-finals; then the final and the match for bronze. Two points for a win, one for a draw, ties split by goal percentage.
af: Agt lande naby joune op die wêreldranglys, in twee poele van vier. Die boonste twee van elke poel gaan deur na die halfeindstryde; dan die eindstryd en die wedstryd om brons. Twee punte vir 'n wen, een vir gelykop; gelyke punte word deur doelpersentasie geskei.
zu: Amazwe ayisishiyagalombili aseduze nelakho ohlwini lwamazinga lomhlaba, emaqoqweni amabili amazwe amane. Amabili aphezulu eqoqo ngalinye adlulela kuma-semi-final; bese kuba owamanqamu nomdlalo wethusi. Amaphuzu amabili ngokuwina, elilodwa ngokulingana; uma kulingene kunqunywa ngephesenti lamagoli.
xh: Izizwe ezisibhozo ezikufutshane nelakho kuluhlu lwamanqanaba ehlabathi, kumaqoqo amabini ezine. Ezimbini eziphezulu kwiqoqo ngalinye ziya kwii-semi-final; emva koko owamagqibela nomdlalo wobhedu. Amanqaku amabini ngokuphumelela, elinye ngokulingana; ukulingana kwahlulwa yipesenti yamanqaku afakiweyo.
st: Dinaha tse robedi tse haufi le ya hao maemong a lefatshe, ka dihlopha tse pedi tsa tse nne. Tse pedi tse hodimo sehlopheng ka seng di fetela semi-final; ebe ho latela makgaolakgang le papadi ya boronse. Dintlha tse pedi bakeng sa tlholo, e le nngwe bakeng sa ho lekana; ha di lekana ho shejwa diperesente tsa dikolo.
tn: Dinaga di le robedi tse di gaufi le ya gago mo maemong a lefatshe, mo ditlhopheng di le pedi tsa di le nne. Tse pedi tsa ntlha mo setlhopheng sengwe le sengwe di ya kwa semi-final; go latela final le motshameko wa boronse. Dintlha di le pedi tsa phenyo, nngwe ya go lekana; fa di lekana go lebiwa diperesente tsa dikolo.
ny: Mayiko asanu ndi atatu oyandikana ndi lanu pa mndandanda wa dziko lonse, m'magulu awiri a anayi. Awiri apamwamba pa gulu lililonse amapita ku semi-final; kenako fainolo ndi masewera a bronze. Mapointi awiri pakupambana, limodzi pofanana; ofanana amasiyanitsidwa ndi peresenti ya zigoli.

sw: Mataifa manane yaliyo karibu na lako katika viwango vya dunia, katika makundi mawili ya manne. Mawili ya juu ya kila kundi yanafuzu nusu fainali; kisha fainali na mechi ya shaba. Pointi mbili kwa ushindi, moja kwa sare, timu zikilingana hutenganishwa kwa asilimia ya magoli.
ms: Lapan negara yang hampir dengan kedudukan dunia anda, dalam dua kumpulan berempat. Dua teratas setiap kumpulan mara ke separuh akhir; kemudian final dan perlawanan gangsa. Dua mata untuk menang, satu untuk seri, kedudukan sama ditentukan peratusan gol.
zh: 八个世界排名与你相近的国家，分成两个四队小组。每组前两名晋级半决赛；随后进行决赛和铜牌赛。胜一场得两分，平一场得一分，积分相同按得分率排名。
